title: 冠狀動脈繞道手術（CABG）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出冠狀動脈繞道手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Coronary artery bypass grafting.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：正中胸骨切開、左內乳動脈取用、體外循環、遠端／近端吻合與離機。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Median sternotomy, LIMA harvest, cardiopulmonary bypass, distal/proximal anastomoses and weaning.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
心臟完全停跳。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Complete arrest achieved.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
LIMA 完整、流量良好。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
LIMA intact with good flow.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
心臟完全停跳。
成功離機並以 protamine 中和肝素。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Complete arrest achieved.
Weaned and heparin reversed with protamine.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
各遠端吻合通暢。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
All distals patent.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依冠狀動脈繞道手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Coronary artery bypass grafting.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
LIMA 完整、流量良好。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
LIMA intact with good flow.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 冠狀動脈繞道手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Coronary artery bypass grafting.

steps.title: 正中胸骨切開與內乳動脈取用
steps.titleEn: Median sternotomy and internal mammary artery harvest
steps.objective: 安全開胸並取用左內乳動脈（LIMA）。
steps.objectiveEn: Open the chest safely and harvest the LIMA.
steps.instruction: 胸骨鋸沿中線，骨蠟止血；以帶蒂或骨骼化方式取 LIMA 至分叉處，罌粟鹼噴灑防痙攣，遠端暫不切斷。
steps.instructionEn: Saw along the midline, bone-wax haemostasis; harvest the LIMA pedicled or skeletonised to the bifurcation, papaverine to prevent spasm, divide distally later.
steps.observation: 評估 LIMA 血流（自由流量 > 60 mL/min）。
steps.observationEn: Assess LIMA free flow (> 60 mL/min).
steps.failure: 胸膜破損與分支出血是常見問題；取用時避免牽拉傷。
steps.failureEn: Pleural entry and branch bleeding are common; avoid traction injury.
steps.check: LIMA 完整、流量良好。
steps.checkEn: LIMA intact with good flow.

knowledge.title: 為何 LIMA
knowledge.text: LIMA 接左前降支的 10 年通暢率 > 90%，是生存率優勢的來源。
knowledge.textEn: LIMA to LAD patency exceeds 90% at ten years and underlies the survival advantage.

quiz.question: 「正中胸骨切開與內乳動脈取用」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Median sternotomy and internal mammary artery harvest'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
LIMA 完整、流量良好。
各遠端吻合通暢。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
LIMA intact with good flow.
All distals patent.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 肝素化、插管與體外循環建立
steps.objective: 建立安全的體外循環。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish cardiopulmonary bypass safely.
steps.instruction: 肝素 300–400 U/kg 使 ACT > 480 s；升主動脈插管與右心房兩階段靜脈插管；確認流量 2.2–2.4 L/min/m²。
steps.instructionEn: Heparin 300–400 U/kg for ACT > 480 s; ascending aortic and two-stage right atrial cannulation; confirm flow 2.2–2.4 L/min/m².
steps.observation: 記錄 ACT、灌注壓與氧合。
steps.observationEn: Record ACT, perfusion pressure and oxygenation.
steps.failure: 主動脈粥樣硬化處插管可致中風；先以 epiaortic 超音波檢查。
steps.failureEn: Cannulating an atherosclerotic aorta risks stroke; screen with epiaortic ultrasound.
steps.check: 體外循環參數穩定。
steps.checkEn: Bypass parameters stable.

knowledge.title: ACT
knowledge.text: < 400 s 不可開始體外循環。
knowledge.textEn: Never start bypass below 400 s.

quiz.question: 「肝素化、插管與體外循環建立」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Heparinisation, cannulation and bypass'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
體外循環參數穩定。
LIMA 完整、流量良好。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Bypass parameters stable.
LIMA intact with good flow.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 主動脈夾閉與心肌保護
steps.objective: 停跳心臟並給予心肌保護液。
steps.objectiveEn: Arrest the heart and deliver cardioplegia.
steps.instruction: 夾閉升主動脈，順行（主動脈根）±逆行（冠狀竇）灌注冷血或 del Nido 停跳液，每 20 分鐘重複或依方案。
steps.instructionEn: Clamp the ascending aorta; antegrade (root) ± retrograde (coronary sinus) cold blood or del Nido cardioplegia, repeat every 20 minutes or per protocol.
steps.observation: 確認心電靜止與心肌溫度。
steps.observationEn: Confirm electrical silence and myocardial temperature.
steps.failure: 停跳不完全代表灌注不足（主動脈瓣逆流或狹窄遠端）。
steps.failureEn: Incomplete arrest means inadequate delivery (aortic regurgitation or distal to stenoses).
steps.check: 心臟完全停跳。
steps.checkEn: Complete arrest achieved.

knowledge.title: 逆行灌注
knowledge.text: 可保護狹窄遠端心肌並清除順行灌注的氣體。
knowledge.textEn: Protects myocardium beyond stenoses and de-airs antegrade delivery.

quiz.question: 「主動脈夾閉與心肌保護」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Aortic cross-clamp and myocardial protection'?
options: 成功離機並以 protamine 中和肝素。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
心臟完全停跳。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Weaned and heparin reversed with protamine.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Complete arrest achieved.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 遠端吻合
steps.objective: 完成每一條目標血管的遠端吻合。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the distal anastomosis to each target vessel.
steps.instruction: 切開冠狀動脈 4–6 mm，以 7-0／8-0 Prolene 連續縫合；先做最差血管，LIMA–LAD 通常最後以保留心肌保護。
steps.instructionEn: Arteriotomy 4–6 mm; continuous 7-0/8-0 Prolene; graft the worst vessel first and LIMA–LAD last to preserve protection.
steps.observation: 以 probe 確認吻合口通暢、無出血。
steps.observationEn: Probe patency and check for bleeding.
steps.failure: 後壁縫合勾到對側壁會造成狹窄。
steps.failureEn: Catching the back wall narrows the anastomosis.
steps.check: 各遠端吻合通暢。
steps.checkEn: All distals patent.

knowledge.title: 目標血管選擇
knowledge.text: 直徑 ≥ 1.5 mm、狹窄 ≥ 70% 且供應存活心肌。
knowledge.textEn: Diameter ≥ 1.5 mm, stenosis ≥ 70% and supplying viable myocardium.

quiz.question: 「遠端吻合」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Distal anastomoses'?
options: 各遠端吻合通暢。
體外循環參數穩定。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: All distals patent.
Bypass parameters stable.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 近端吻合與離機
steps.objective: 完成近端吻合並脫離體外循環。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete proximals and wean from bypass.
steps.instruction: 鬆開夾鉗（或側壁夾）在升主動脈打孔 4 mm 做近端吻合；排氣、復溫、恢復心律（必要時去顫／起搏），逐步降低流量觀察血壓與 TEE。
steps.instructionEn: Release the clamp (or side-bite) and punch 4 mm aortotomies for proximals; de-air, rewarm, restore rhythm (defibrillate/pace if needed), reduce flow while watching pressure and TOE.
steps.observation: 記錄離機時血流動力學與強心藥。
steps.observationEn: Record haemodynamics and inotropes at weaning.
steps.failure: 離機困難需評估移植血管流量（TTFM）與心室功能。
steps.failureEn: Difficulty weaning: assess graft flow (TTFM) and ventricular function.
steps.check: 成功離機並以 protamine 中和肝素。
steps.checkEn: Weaned and heparin reversed with protamine.

knowledge.title: 移植血管流量測量
knowledge.text: PI < 5、平均流量 > 15–20 mL/min 表示通暢。
knowledge.textEn: PI < 5 and mean flow > 15–20 mL/min indicate patency.

quiz.question: 「近端吻合與離機」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proximal anastomoses and weaning'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
成功離機並以 protamine 中和肝素。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Weaned and heparin reversed with protamine.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出冠狀動脈繞道手術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Coronary artery bypass grafting and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 成功離機並以 protamine 中和肝素。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Weaned and heparin reversed with protamine.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 不停跳冠狀動脈繞道

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Off-pump CABG.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：心臟固定器、血管分流管與血流動力學管理。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Stabilisers, intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 已正確完成「心臟固定器」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: 'Stabilisers' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Off-pump CABG.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Off-pump CABG.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：心臟固定器
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「心臟固定器」在不停跳冠狀動脈繞道中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Stabilisers' within Off-pump CABG, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「心臟固定器」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Stabilisers': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「心臟固定器」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Stabilisers'.
steps.failure: 若「心臟固定器」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Stabilisers' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「心臟固定器」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Stabilisers' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「心臟固定器」是不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Stabilisers' is a core component of Off-pump CABG; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：心臟固定器」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Stabilisers'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「心臟固定器」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Stabilisers' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：血管分流管與血流動力學管理
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」在不停跳冠狀動脈繞道中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' within Off-pump CABG, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management'.
steps.failure: 若「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」是不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' is a core component of Off-pump CABG; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：血管分流管與血流動力學管理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management'?
options: 已正確完成「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: 'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「心臟固定器」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Stabilisers' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出不停跳冠狀動脈繞道的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Off-pump CABG and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「血管分流管與血流動力學管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'intracoronary shunts and haemodynamic management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 繞道血管取用：內乳動脈、橈動脈與大隱靜脈
titleEn: Conduit harvesting: IMA, radial artery and saphenous vein

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明繞道血管取用：內乳動脈、橈動脈與大隱靜脈的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Conduit harvesting: IMA, radial artery and saphenous vein applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：骨骼化取用、內視鏡靜脈取用與血管通暢率。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Skeletonised harvest, endoscopic vein harvest and graft patency.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 骨骼化取用、內視鏡靜脈取用與血管通暢率。
knowledge.textEn: Skeletonised harvest, endoscopic vein harvest and graft patency.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 準備清單完成。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「內視鏡靜脈取用與血管通暢率」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'endoscopic vein harvest and graft patency' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
準備清單完成。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「骨骼化取用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'Skeletonised harvest' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟

steps.checkEn: 'Skeletonised harvest' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.textEn: 'Skeletonised harvest' is a core component of Conduit harvesting: IMA, radial artery and saphenous vein; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：骨骼化取用」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Skeletonised harvest'?
options: 已正確完成「骨骼化取用」並以文字或數據留下證據。

stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出主動脈瓣置換的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Surgical aortic valve replacement.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：瓣膜選擇、瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Prosthesis selection, annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。

steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具

knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「瓣膜選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Prosthesis selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依主動脈瓣置換的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Surgical aortic valve replacement.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「瓣膜選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Prosthesis selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 主動脈瓣置換的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Surgical aortic valve replacement.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：瓣膜選擇
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「瓣膜選擇」在主動脈瓣置換中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Prosthesis selection' within Surgical aortic valve replacement, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「瓣膜選擇」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Prosthesis selection': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「瓣膜選擇」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Prosthesis selection'.
steps.failure: 若「瓣膜選擇」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Prosthesis selection' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「瓣膜選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Prosthesis selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「瓣膜選擇」是主動脈瓣置換的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Prosthesis selection' is a core component of Surgical aortic valve replacement; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：瓣膜選擇」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Prosthesis selection'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「瓣膜選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Prosthesis selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」在主動脈瓣置換中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy' within Surgical aortic valve replacement, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy'.
steps.failure: 若「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」是主動脈瓣置換的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy' is a core component of Surgical aortic valve replacement; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy'?
options: 已正確完成「瓣環縫合技巧與抗凝策略」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: 'annular suturing and anticoagulation strategy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出主動脈瓣置換的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Surgical aortic valve replacement and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: Ross 手術（肺動脈瓣自體移植）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出Ross 手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Ross procedure.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依Ross 手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Ross procedure.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: Ross 手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Ross procedure.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」在Ross 手術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction' within Ross procedure, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction'.
steps.failure: 若「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」是Ross 手術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction' is a core component of Ross procedure; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「年輕患者以自體肺動脈瓣置換主動脈瓣與同種移植重建」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Pulmonary autograft for young patients with homograft reconstruction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.
