steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「B 型剝離與胸主動脈瘤的支架人工血管與左鎖骨下動脈處理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Stent-grafts for type B dissection and thoracic aneurysm' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出胸主動脈腔內修復的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Thoracic endovascular aortic repair and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 迷宮手術（心房顫動外科消融）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出迷宮手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Cox-Maze procedure.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 已正確完成「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依迷宮手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Cox-Maze procedure.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 迷宮手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Cox-Maze procedure.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」在迷宮手術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' within Cox-Maze procedure, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision'.
steps.failure: 若「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」是迷宮手術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' is a core component of Cox-Maze procedure; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「雙極射頻／冷凍病灶組與左心耳切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Bipolar radiofrequency/cryo lesion sets and appendage excision' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出迷宮手術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Cox-Maze procedure and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 左心室輔助器（LVAD）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出左心室輔助器的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Left ventricular assist device.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：HeartMate 3 植入、驅動線照護、抗凝與併發症。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: HeartMate 3 implantation, driveline care, anticoagulation and complications.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「驅動線照護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'driveline care' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「抗凝與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'anticoagulation and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依左心室輔助器的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Left ventricular assist device.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 左心室輔助器的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Left ventricular assist device.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：HeartMate 3 植入
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「HeartMate 3 植入」在左心室輔助器中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'HeartMate 3 implantation' within Left ventricular assist device, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「HeartMate 3 植入」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'HeartMate 3 implantation': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「HeartMate 3 植入」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'HeartMate 3 implantation'.
steps.failure: 若「HeartMate 3 植入」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'HeartMate 3 implantation' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「HeartMate 3 植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'HeartMate 3 implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「HeartMate 3 植入」是左心室輔助器的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'HeartMate 3 implantation' is a core component of Left ventricular assist device; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：HeartMate 3 植入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: HeartMate 3 implantation'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「抗凝與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「HeartMate 3 植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'anticoagulation and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'HeartMate 3 implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：驅動線照護」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: driveline care'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「驅動線照護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'driveline care' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「驅動線照護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「抗凝與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「抗凝與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「驅動線照護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'anticoagulation and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'driveline care' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出左心室輔助器的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Left ventricular assist device and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 已正確完成「驅動線照護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: 'driveline care' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 心臟移植

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出心臟移植的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Heart transplantation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：受贈者評估、雙腔吻合、免疫抑制與排斥監測。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Recipient selection, bicaval anastomosis, immunosuppression and rejection surveillance.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依心臟移植的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Heart transplantation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 心臟移植的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Heart transplantation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：受贈者評估
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「受贈者評估」在心臟移植中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Recipient selection' within Heart transplantation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「受贈者評估」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Recipient selection': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「受贈者評估」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Recipient selection'.
steps.failure: 若「受贈者評估」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Recipient selection' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「受贈者評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Recipient selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「受贈者評估」是心臟移植的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Recipient selection' is a core component of Heart transplantation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：受贈者評估」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Recipient selection'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「受贈者評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Recipient selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：雙腔吻合
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「雙腔吻合」在心臟移植中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'bicaval anastomosis' within Heart transplantation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「雙腔吻合」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'bicaval anastomosis': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「雙腔吻合」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'bicaval anastomosis'.
steps.failure: 若「雙腔吻合」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'bicaval anastomosis' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「雙腔吻合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'bicaval anastomosis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「雙腔吻合」是心臟移植的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'bicaval anastomosis' is a core component of Heart transplantation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：雙腔吻合」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: bicaval anastomosis'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「雙腔吻合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'bicaval anastomosis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 3：免疫抑制與排斥監測
steps.titleEn: Key element 3: immunosuppression and rejection surveillance
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「免疫抑制與排斥監測」在心臟移植中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' within Heart transplantation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「免疫抑制與排斥監測」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「免疫抑制與排斥監測」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance'.
steps.failure: 若「免疫抑制與排斥監測」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「免疫抑制與排斥監測」是心臟移植的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' is a core component of Heart transplantation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 3：免疫抑制與排斥監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 3: immunosuppression and rejection surveillance'?
options: 已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「雙腔吻合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'bicaval anastomosis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出心臟移植的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Heart transplantation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「免疫抑制與排斥監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'immunosuppression and rejection surveillance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「受贈者評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Recipient selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 葉克膜（ECMO）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出葉克膜的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：VA／VV 模式、插管、抗凝、差異性缺氧與脫離。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: VA/VV configurations, cannulation, anticoagulation, differential hypoxia and weaning.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「差異性缺氧與脫離」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'differential hypoxia and weaning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「插管」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「抗凝」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'cannulation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'anticoagulation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「抗凝」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'anticoagulation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 已正確完成「差異性缺氧與脫離」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「抗凝」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: 'differential hypoxia and weaning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'anticoagulation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 已正確完成「差異性缺氧與脫離」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: 'differential hypoxia and weaning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依葉克膜的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 葉克膜的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：VA／VV 模式
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「VA／VV 模式」在葉克膜中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'VA/VV configurations' within Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「VA／VV 模式」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'VA/VV configurations': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「VA／VV 模式」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'VA/VV configurations'.
steps.failure: 若「VA／VV 模式」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'VA/VV configurations' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「VA／VV 模式」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'VA/VV configurations' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「VA／VV 模式」是葉克膜的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'VA/VV configurations' is a core component of Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：VA／VV 模式」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: VA/VV configurations'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「VA／VV 模式」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'VA/VV configurations' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.
